deal_value.notes: All-cash consideration of $65 million; announced November 7, 2022

calculable.calculation: $65M purchase price / (~$1M per month revenue x 12 = ~$12M annualized run-rate revenue) = ~5.4x
inputs: $65M all-cash deal value — MeridianLink press release, https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20221107005914/en/MeridianLink-Announces-Acquisition-of-OpenClose

OpenClose revenue of approximately $1M per month, growing at a high-teens rate, per MeridianLink CFO Sean Blitchok on the Q3 2022 earnings call — reported by National Mortgage News, https://www.nationalmortgagenews.com/news/meridianlink-buys-openclose-for-65-million-in-bid-to-reach-more-banks
calculable.caveats: Revenue input is an approximate run-rate stated by acquirer management ('approximately $1 million per month'), not an audited annual figure; annualizing a monthly figure assumes a stable run-rate

sources.title: MeridianLink Announces Acquisition of OpenClose (Business Wire press release)
MeridianLink buys OpenClose for $65 million in bid to reach more banks (National Mortgage News)
MeridianLink acquires mortgage fintech OpenClose for $65M (HousingWire)

notes: No multiple was published by the company or trade press; the ~5.4x is implied from the disclosed $65M price and the CFO's ~$1M/month revenue disclosure on the Q3 2022 earnings call as reported by National Mortgage News. Deal closed November 8, 2022.
